details:
* SECURITY UPDATE: Use-after-free of a pending dedicated ACK buffer when a
     TLS session is freed during session promotion or expiry
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-12996.patch: add the check_session_buf_not_used()
       safeguard, including its ks->ack_write_buf check, and call it before
       every site in tls_multi_process() that frees or resets a session
     - CVE-2026-12996
     - the safeguard does not exist in 2.4.7, so it is introduced here already
       in its post-CVE-2026-12996 form; as a result this patch also fixes
       CVE-2026-40215, which shares the same safeguard
